01 / About Rubesh

Business experience.
An entrepreneurial vision.

My business interests span real estate, property management, hospitality and investment opportunities. More than two decades of international business experience inform the way I assess opportunities, build partnerships and approach long-term growth.

“Building lasting value in real estate and property businesses through thoughtful decisions, trusted relationships and strong partnerships.”

I’m Rubesh Mohammed, Founder and Managing Director of Ekal Ventures. My business interests are centred on real estate, property management, hospitality and investment opportunities.

I see property and real estate as long-term businesses built on understanding people, places and opportunities. Through Ekal Ventures, I am focused on developing real estate opportunities, approaching property management with care, and building relationships with clients, property owners, investors and business partners.

My earlier career across Qatar Airways, Oman Air, Bahrain Air and flydubai gave me extensive international exposure and a strong foundation in commercial leadership, sales and relationship management. I now apply that perspective to evaluating opportunities, working with partners and building ventures with a long-term outlook.

Ethics, trust and integrity guide how I approach business. Whether the opportunity involves property, hospitality or investment, my commitment is to act responsibly, nurture lasting relationships and work towards sustainable value.
